resources.name: Lattice constants for TMB₂ compounds

access.notes: Experimental lattice parameters a and c from the paper's Table I will be provided inline in the task instructions (instruction.md).

resources.notes: Crystal structures (space group P6/mmm, atomic positions) are standard; a and c are the only required structural input.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials (SSSP efficiency library)

access.notes: Norm-conserving or ultrasoft pseudopotentials for Ta, V, Nb, Ti, Y, and B. The paper used Bachelet-Hamann-Schlüter and Vanderbilt types; modern public libraries are acceptable.

resources.notes: Any well-tested open-source pseudopotential set can be used.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or alternative DFT code)

access.notes: Open-source DFT package capable of phonon and electron-phonon coupling calculations (pw.x, ph.x, etc.).

resources.notes: Any open-source code producing the equivalent phonon and electron-phonon quantities (e.g., ABINIT) is acceptable.

notes: All resources are public. Lattice constants are bundled; pseudopotentials and DFT code are fetched by the agent from the specified URLs.
